CustomField.description: # of points awarded for this quote/order based on New Total Order Sales (Portal) $ and the contact's reward step configuration - we replaced this with New OCC_Rewards (QOC) to account for the OCC Reward Override field. 7/24/18 Stacy
CustomField.formula: IF(Buyer__r.OCC_Rewards__c = True, IF(Buyer__r.OCC_RewardStep__c != 0 && Buyer__r.OCC_RewardStepValue__c != 0, IF(OCC_RewardStepValue__c != 0 || OCC_RewardStep__c != 0, FLOOR( New_Total_Order_Sales__c / OCC_RewardStep__c) * OCC_RewardStepValue__c, 0), 0), 0)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Points awarded for this quote/order based on the order $ and reward step setup
CustomField.label: Old OCC_Rewards (QOC)
